build_TwoStageDetector: build a two-stage detector with backbone, RPN head, and ROI head for object detection
test_forward_train: test the TwoStageDetector forward_train method with ground truth bboxes and labels to compute losses
run_simple_test: run the TwoStageDetector simple_test method to perform inference without augmentation on input images
extract_feat_TwoStageDetector: extract features from the backbone and neck of the TwoStageDetector for downstream tasks
review_init_weights: review the TwoStageDetector init_weights method to initialize backbone, neck, RPN, and ROI head weights
